title: The worker brief opens with the outcome, carries one pre-submit list and stays under 450 fixed words
description: Renders a worker brief for a fixed feature item under the claude, opencode and codex runtimes: it opens with the item, why, simplest and when it is done, names complete --head as the last action, carries one numbered pre-submit list (sync, build and test:affected, review self, sandbox-only failures), asks for the bound proof to fail first, gives rm/mv and OpenCode guidance only to their runtime, states autonomy once, and holds at most 450 words besides the item's own data.

steps.name: the worker brief is outcome-first with one pre-submit list under 450 fixed words
